about: Novokuznetsk B. V. Volynov International Airport, the air gateway to the Sheregesh resort. The new 19,500 sq. m terminal opened on 25 February 2025, capacity 1.73 million passengers a year.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Buses 120, 130 and 160 run from 5:20 to 22:34. No. 160 from Oktyabrsky Ave, about 60 minutes, 76 ₽. No. 120 from the Krasnogorskaya mine, about 80 minutes, 50 ₽. No. 130 from Dom Veteranov, about 90 minutes, 50 ₽. Taxi about 40 minutes, roughly 800 ₽.

terminals.title: Terminal
terminals.text: The new terminal opened on 25 February 2025. 13 check-in counters, 6 boarding gates, 3 jet bridges. Check-in and baggage drop close 40 minutes before departure, boarding 20 minutes before.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Domestic business lounge on Level 3, open while flights are being handled. Adults 3,400 ₽, children 2–12 years 1,700 ₽, under 2 free, up to 3 hours. Access via MILEONAIR, Every Lounge, UniPass, Grey Wall Pass, Golden Key, Persona aero. VIP lounge on Levels 1–2 on request, departure from 18,900 ₽.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage on Level 1, open round the clock. Standard baggage up to 203 cm in total dimensions: 400 ₽ for the first 24 hours, then 200 ₽. Oversized: 750 ₽ for the first 24 hours, then 400 ₽. One item up to 30 kg.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: Hotel on the airport grounds, 33 Aeroportovaya St. 27 rooms, from 4,200 ₽ per day. Front desk round the clock: +7 (3843) 993 455. The hotel café is open round the clock.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 2, in the landside area of the terminal. Open round the clock, free. Admits a child under 7 accompanied by one adult. There is a kitchen with a fridge and a microwave, a shower, a changing table; no sterilisers.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: P1 drop-off and pick-up only, parking prohibited. P2 short-stay: 15 minutes free, 16–60 minutes 300 ₽, from the 2nd to the 4th hour 100 ₽/hour, over 4 hours 700 ₽/day. P3 long-stay: 15 minutes free, 500 ₽/day for up to 6 days. A part day is charged as a full day.
